'''Turtuff''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Gibber]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Rockshell]] at 6 silver stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Rarely speaks up and has a habit of fading into the background. But you can always count on Turtuff to step up when help is needed."

Turtuff is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A yellowish-tan tortoise with a white chin, large brown eyebrows, and a rocky brown shell that's almost larger than its body. Its eyes are black with brown highlights.

Gibber's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces tan with orange, white with light yellow, and brown becomes turquoise green.

==Evolution Trial==
Turtuff's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 silver stars/49 copies. To evolve it into [[Rockshell]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Turtuff to increase stats 3 times.
* In [[Island Gold Rush]] use 5,000 energy drinks.

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "A Turtuff thought it should shape its stones like a dragon fruit and be as cute as a [[Frugling]]."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "Having grown larger in body, Turtuff's movements are slower but steadier. When attacked, Turtuff remains calm, tanking all damage with a thick, heavy shell."
